notes.title: Roots Devour Ready for Steam Next Fest – New Demo Update Live!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We are Rewinding Games, the developers of the Lovecraftian indie game Roots Devour. We’re excited to announce that Roots Devour is officially joining the February Steam Next Fest! The demo is now available for download on Steam, with the latest update v0.1.1.0 released simultaneously. Come and experience the latest version!

v0.1.1.0 Update Highlights
Inspiration System:
A new Inspiration System has been added! Players can unlock knowledge about inspiration gain at the Ritual Place, such as: “Gain 20% Inspiration whenever you open a card pack.”
When the Inspiration bar is full, you will receive a gift from the Mother, allowing you to choose certain cards to add to your deck.

Card Expansion & Balancing:
New Card: Ancient Scroll – When played, it grants 50% Inspiration instantly, but it may also shuffle Evil into your deck.
Adjusted effects for most played cards. Introducing new card decks: Seed, Flower, Mutation, and Evil. Each deck represents a unique playstyle—use them to aid your exploration of the forest.

Enhanced Exploration Experience:
Paths traversed by the Root will now become Corrupted. When the roots regenerate, these paths may undergo mutations. On Corrupted paths, Root will now act autonomously, allowing players to skip previously explored areas.
While exploring the forest, you may discover Hearts of the Tree, granting permanent attribute bonuses.
Some hidden Easter eggs have been quietly scattered throughout the ever-changing forest.

The full version of Roots Devour is currently in development, and the demo content does not represent the final quality of the game. If you encounter any issues or have feedback, please use the "Feedback" and "Bug Report" options in the main menu to share your thoughts with us!

notes.title: 《Roots Devour》Demo 1.0.3 Version Update
notes.notes:
BUG Fixes

- Fixed an issue where connecting stone cracks would cause the game to freeze.
- Fixed an issue with the [Cat] card being incorrect.
- Fixed an issue with the unlocking of Talents.
- Fixed an issue where the [Owl] would speak randomly when placed.
- Fixed an issue where the path above would be relocked after completing the game.
- Fixed an issue where items in the shop could not be clicked for purchase.
- Fixed an issue where follower cards would disappear unexpectedly.
- Fixed an issue where the [Owl] would fly back to the hand when returning to the forest, even if it was killed.

Optimizations

- Optimized rendering performance by adjusting lighting rendering to reduce GPU consumption.
- Optimized the flickering effect of lightning in tutorial levels.
- Optimized the unlock prompt for the Alter, making it more obvious.
- Optimized the card description for [Forest Rat].
- Optimized the tutorial guide for water consumption in the tutorial levels.

- Adjusted the King Rat's health capacity from infinite to 200.
- Adjusted the card distribution rules: some cards now require unlocking outside the run before appearing in the random pool.
- Adjusted the water restoration effect of the [Fountain] card: now, [Fountain] cards drawn from the deck restore 20 water points only after being connected, instead of restoring immediately upon appearing.

- Added feedback in the ritual house in the forest when the connection sequence is incorrect.
- Added additional story content related to the [Owl].

BUG Feedback Channels

You can provide feedback through the bug feedback button in the game's settings menu.  
You're also welcomed to join our Discord.
